goal.title: Add the API reference tool
criteria: The tool lists every public name and member lacking a doc comment and exits with a failure
With every name documented it exits successfully
The tool writes reference data holding every public name, its signature, description, parameters, return value, errors and members, and the package version
Inherited members appear on a class, and names outside the entry point, protected members and `@internal` members do not
A name that is both a value and a type is one entry, and overloads are each listed
TypeDoc is not a runtime dependency of `xcl-lang`

scope.rule: Change only the files that belong to this item; change nothing that belongs to another task.

verdicts.evidence: `.github/scripts/api-reference.mjs` main() (lines 794-826) collects `missing` from `generate()` when `--check` is set, prints `<id>: no doc comment` to stderr and returns 1. `undocumented()` (lines 330-356) reports every public name and member with no comment text. Test `the check fails, naming an undocumented public method` (`api-reference.test.mjs` lines 65-79) asserts status 1 and the line `xcl-lang.Widget.spin: no doc comment`. The supplied verification run of the Config.apply case (exit 1, `xcl-lang.Config.apply: no doc comment`) agrees with this code.

With every name documented, `missing` is empty and main() returns 0 (lines 816-825). Test `the check passes on a package where every public name is documented` (`api-reference.test.mjs` lines 81-88) asserts status 0 and empty stderr. Supplied verification: `--check` on the package exits 0.

`api-reference.mjs` generate() (lines 773-787) writes `version` from the package's package.json, plus sections of entries. Each entry() (lines 444-490) carries `signature` (declarationSignature/signatureText), `description` (description()), `parameters` (parameters()), `returns` (returns()), `raises` (errors from `@throws {@link}`), and `members` (members(), with constructor, own and inherited). Test `the data carries the package version, every entry and its members` (test lines 266-307) checks version, members, signature, parameters and returns; test at lines 164-181 checks `raises`. The supplied run wrote data with version 0.0.0-dev, matching package.json line 3.

Inherited members: members() (lines 302-326) keeps `inheritedFrom`, and entry() sets `inheritedFrom` (lines 479-482). Test `an inherited member is listed on the class that inherits it` (test lines 90-109) asserts `xcl-lang.Derived.hello` with inheritedFrom `xcl-lang.Base`. Outside entry point: load() uses `entryPoints: src/index.ts` (lines 68-81), and test lines 128-138 asserts a non-exported class is absent. Protected, private and @internal: load() sets excludeInternal, excludeProtected, excludePrivate, and test lines 140-162 asserts only the public names are present. Note that the test for internal/protected only checks the listed keys, and the exclusion relies on TypeDoc options; the supplied verification did not run this test separately, but the 13-test pass covers it.

`api-reference.mjs` byName() and primaryOf() (lines 139-154) group reflections by name, so a value and a type under one name form one item. entry() (lines 455-459) renders each form as an overload. Test `a value and a type exported under one name are one entry with both forms` (test lines 201-221) asserts one entry with kind type and overloads `type Shape = ...` and `Shape(sides: number): Shape`. Overloaded functions: callable() (lines 508-531) emits one overload per signature. Test `every signature of an overloaded function is listed` (test lines 223-244) asserts both `twice` signatures.

xcl-typescript package.json lines 33-35: `dependencies` holds only `@bufbuild/protobuf` 2.17.0. typedoc 0.28.20 (line 42) and markdown-it 14.3.3 (line 40) sit in `devDependencies`. `src` has no import of typedoc or markdown-it (grep found no matches). The script imports both, but it is a dev-only script under .github/scripts. Side note, outside the criteria: the staged diff also modifies README.md (a new Development section), which is not in this item's file list. The rule to change only this item's files is not a criterion, so it does not change a verdict.
